question: To whom is the same ritual rule declared applicable in the case of the liṅga?
premises: The procedure applies likewise in the case of the liṅga.
The address is directed to those initiated into Śiva.
inference: The same rule applies also in the case of the liṅga, O Śiva-initiated ones.
uncertainties: The form darma may reflect a transmitted spelling of dharma.
plain_english: O Śiva-initiated ones, the same rule applies likewise in the case of the liṅga.
